WITH large_orders AS (
  SELECT o.account_id, o.amount
  FROM `order` o
  WHERE o.amount > 2802
),
orders_with_districts AS (
  SELECT lo.account_id, lo.amount, d.A3
  FROM large_orders lo
  JOIN account a ON lo.account_id = a.account_id
  JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
),
group_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    owd.account_id, 
    owd.A3, 
    AVG(owd.amount) as group_avg
  FROM orders_with_districts owd
  GROUP BY owd.account_id, owd.A3
),
overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(ga.group_avg) as overall_avg
  FROM group_averages ga
)
SELECT 
  ga.account_id,
  ga.A3 as region,
  ga.group_avg,
  ga.group_avg - oa.overall_avg as difference
FROM group_averages ga
CROSS JOIN overall_average oa
WHERE ga.group_avg > oa.overall_avg
ORDER BY difference DESC
LIMIT 10
